films.title: 许鞍华（荣誉）
films.synopsis: 香港导演许鞍华。第31届釜山国际电影节山茶花奖得主，表彰其推动女性电影的贡献。
films.synopsisEn: Hong Kong director Ann Hui, recipient of the Camellia Award at the 31st Busan International Film Festival for her contributions to advancing women's cinema.

films.title: 我的母亲
films.synopsis: 印尼导演 Eddie Cahyono 执导。工薪阶层寡妇在成年女儿于沙特入狱后挣扎求生。釜山31 Busan Award 评审团特别奖。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Indonesian filmmaker Eddie Cahyono. A working-class widow struggles to survive after her adult daughter is imprisoned in Saudi Arabia. Special Jury Prize for the Busan Award at Busan 31.

films.title: 平凡之路
films.synopsis: 台湾导演李云禅执导成长剧情片。釜山31 Busan Award 最佳导演。
films.synopsisEn: Coming-of-age drama directed by Taiwanese filmmaker Li Yunchan. Best Director, Busan Award at Busan 31.

films.title: 水泥之地
films.synopsis: 约旦导演 Asmahan Bkerat 纪录长片处女作。跟随约旦一个混血家庭数代人，面对驱逐与敌意时的韧性。第70届 BFI 伦敦电影节 Grierson 纪录片奖。
films.synopsisEn: Documentary feature debut from Jordanian director Asmahan Bkerat. Follows generations of a mixed-heritage Jordanian family and their resilience in the face of displacement and hostility. Grierson Documentary Award at the 70th BFI London Film Festival.

films.title: 九座通往天堂的庙
films.synopsis: 泰国导演 Sompot Chidgasornpongse 剧情长片处女作。男子听闻母亲将不久于人世的预言后，携家人一日朝圣九座寺庙。戛纳导演双周首映；BFI 伦敦电影节 Sutherland 奖；泰国奥斯卡国际片报送。监制含阿彼察邦·韦拉斯哈古。
films.synopsisEn: Narrative feature debut from Thai director Sompot Chidgasornpongse. After a man hears a prediction that his mother will soon die, he takes his family on a one-day pilgrimage to nine temples. Premiered in Directors' Fortnight at Cannes; Sutherland Award at the BFI London Film Festival; Thailand's Oscar international submission. Among the producers is Apichatpong Weerasethakul.

films.title: 帝国
films.synopsis: 谢尔盖·洛兹尼察执导档案纪录片（约175分钟）。借意大利摄影师在1970年代初苏联拍摄的素材重访帝国社会与文化景观。威尼斯 Open 单元首映；第70届 BFI 伦敦电影节官方竞赛最佳影片。
films.synopsisEn: Archival documentary directed by Sergei Loznitsa (approx. 175 minutes). Uses footage shot in the early 1970s Soviet Union by an Italian photographer to revisit the empire's social and cultural landscape. Premiered in the Venice Open section; Best Film in official competition at the 70th BFI London Film Festival.

films.title: 第十四条
films.synopsis: Ava DuVernay 纪录片，接续《第十三条》。检视美国宪法第十四修正案相关原则近年所受冲击。NYFF64 闭幕片世界首映；Netflix 发行。
films.synopsisEn: Ava DuVernay documentary following 13th. Examines recent assaults on principles tied to the Fourteenth Amendment of the US Constitution. World premiere as closing film of NYFF64; distributed by Netflix.

films.title: 土地的成长
films.titleEn: Growth of the Soil / Markens grøde
films.synopsis: 汉斯·彼得·莫兰德执导。圣塞74主竞赛：阿斯塔·卡玛·奥古斯特银贝壳最佳主演（并列），奥斯卡·达尔斯巴肯最佳摄影。挪威-丹麦-德国。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Hans Petter Moland. Main competition at San Sebastián 74: Silver Shell for Best Leading Performance (tied) for Asta Kamma August, Best Cinematography for Oskar Dahlsbakken. Norway-Denmark-Germany.

films.title: 撑住你的心
films.titleEn: Brace Your Heart / Garrat du váimmu
films.synopsis: 阿曼达·克内尔执导。圣塞巴斯蒂安74主竞赛，获银贝壳最佳导演。瑞典-挪威-丹麦-冰岛-保加利亚联合制作。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Amanda Kernell. Main competition at San Sebastián 74, won the Silver Shell for Best Director. A Sweden-Norway-Denmark-Iceland-Bulgaria co-production.

films.title: 边境
films.synopsis: 阿彪执导。圣塞巴斯蒂安74主竞赛，获评审团特别奖。香港-美国-韩国联合制作。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Abao. Main competition at San Sebastián 74, won the Special Jury Prize. A Hong Kong-USA-South Korea co-production.

films.title: 别无选择
films.synopsis: 朴赞郁执导。李秉宪主演。改编自唐纳德·E·韦斯特莱克小说《斧头》，讲述被裁员的纸厂中层为保住家庭而采取极端手段的讽刺喜剧。威尼斯主竞赛后于釜山30开幕；2026年10月13日韩国电影资料馆放映加长版导演剪辑。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Park Chan-wook. Starring Lee Byung-hun. Adapted from Donald E. Westlake's novel The Ax, it is a satirical comedy about a laid-off mid-level paper-mill manager who takes extreme measures to protect his family. After its Venice main competition slot, it opened Busan's 30th edition; on October 13, 2026, the Korean Film Archive will screen an extended director's cut.

films.title: 猎鹰
films.synopsis: 马可·贝洛基奥执导。皮尔弗兰切斯科·法维诺饰菲亚特-克莱斯勒救星塞尔吉奥·马尔基翁内，路易·加莱尔饰继承人约翰·埃尔坎。传记片围绕马尔基翁内挽救菲亚特与培养埃尔坎。2026年10月已在多伦多开拍，后续转意大利；RAI Cinema International 国际销售。
cast: 皮尔弗兰切斯科·法维诺
瓦莱丽娅·布鲁尼·泰德斯基
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Marco Bellocchio. Pierfrancesco Favino plays Sergio Marchionne, the savior of Fiat-Chrysler, with Louis Garrel as heir John Elkann. The biopic centers on Marchionne rescuing Fiat and grooming Elkann. Filming began in Toronto in October 2026 and will later move to Italy; RAI Cinema International handles international sales.

films.title: 口中的灰烬
films.synopsis: 迭戈·卢纳执导。改编自布伦达·纳瓦罗同名小说。墨西哥裔姐弟前往西班牙与母亲团聚，直面移民、身份与家庭裂隙。圣塞巴斯蒂安74 Horizontes Latinos，获 Euskadi Basque Country 2030 Agenda Award。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Diego Luna. Adapted from Brenda Navarro's novel of the same name. A Mexican brother and sister travel to Spain to reunite with their mother, confronting migration, identity and family fractures. It screened in Horizontes Latinos at San Sebastián 74, winning the Euskadi Basque Country 2030 Agenda Award.

films.title: 加勒纳
films.synopsis: 塔蒂亚娜·韦索执导。两位选角导演穿越墨西哥偏远地区，为一部科幻片寻找非职业演员，旅程挑战其偏见与脆弱。圣塞巴斯蒂安74 WIP Latam 获 EGEDA Platino Industria 最佳奖。Pimienta Films / Elastica Films 制作。
cast: 拉萨罗·加比诺·罗德里格斯

films.title: 恋人回家
films.synopsis: 哥伦比亚导演胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·梅萨第三部长片。麦德林网络主播与残疾美国退伍军人在线发展亲密关系，他的造访使幻想变成不安的实体相遇。圣塞74 WIP Latam 产业奖。

films.title: 女孩
films.synopsis: 舒淇编剧执导长片首作。1980年代末台北，内向少女试图逃离家庭暴力。威尼斯82主竞赛、釜山30最佳导演。金马63最佳剧情片与最佳新导演入围。
films.synopsisEn: Shu Qi's feature screenwriting and directorial debut. In late-1980s Taipei, an introverted teenage girl tries to escape domestic violence. Venice 82 main competition; Busan 30 Best Director. Nominated for Best Narrative Feature and Best New Director at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 双囍
films.synopsis: 许承傑执导。刘冠廷、余香凝主演。金马63最佳剧情片、最佳导演、最佳男主角、最佳女主角入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Hsu Cheng-chieh. Starring Liu Kuan-ting and Jennifer Yu. Nominated for Best Narrative Feature, Best Director, Best Actor and Best Actress at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 善男信女
films.synopsis: 杨两全执导。杨伟伦、钟雪莹主演。金马63最佳剧情片、最佳新导演、最佳男主角、最佳女主角入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Yeung Leung-chuen. Starring Yeung Wai-lun and Chung Suet-ying. Nominated for Best Narrative Feature, Best New Director, Best Actor and Best Actress at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 狂忘警探
films.synopsis: SABU执导。阮经天主演。金马63最佳剧情片、最佳导演、最佳男主角入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by SABU. Starring Ethan Juan. Nominated for Best Narrative Feature, Best Director and Best Actor at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 我们不是陌生人
films.synopsis: 陈哲艺执导。杨雁雁主演。柏林76主竞赛；金马63最佳剧情片、最佳导演、最佳女主角入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Anthony Chen. Starring Yeo Yann Yann. Berlin 76 main competition; nominated for Best Narrative Feature, Best Director and Best Actress at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 告别的年代
films.synopsis: 杨毅恒执导。2026金马影展开幕片。金马63最佳导演入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Yang Yi-heng. Opening film of the 2026 Golden Horse Film Festival. Nominated for Best Director at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 我们不是什么
films.synopsis: 邱礼涛执导。金马63最佳导演入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Herman Yau. Nominated for Best Director at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 阳光女子合唱团
films.synopsis: 翁倩玉相隔多年再入围金马女配角。金马63最佳女配角。
films.synopsisEn: Weng Chien-yu returns to the Golden Horse race after many years with a Best Supporting Actress nomination. Best Supporting Actress at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 午餐
films.synopsis: 马吉德·马吉迪执导。伊朗东南部村庄合同教师为保住学生免费午餐而被迫走私燃油。釜山31 Busan Award 最佳影片，自动获奥斯卡最佳国际影片资格。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Majid Majidi. In a village in southeastern Iran, a contract teacher is forced to smuggle fuel to protect his students' free lunches. Won Best Film at the 31st Busan International Film Festival's Busan Award, earning automatic Oscar eligibility for Best International Feature.

films.title: 加朗斯
films.synopsis: 让娜·埃里执导。阿黛尔·埃克萨科波洛斯饰酗酒女演员加朗斯，影片跟随她八年。法国片名 Garance，戛纳英文片单作 Another Day。第79届戛纳主竞赛；2026年9月23日法国上映。
cast: 阿黛尔·埃克萨科波洛斯
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Jeanne Herry. Adèle Exarchopoulos plays Garance, an alcoholic actress, and the film follows her over eight years. French title Garance; the Cannes English lineup lists it as Another Day. In Competition at the 79th Cannes Film Festival; French release on September 23, 2026.

films.title: 生日派对
films.titleEn: The Birthday Party / Histoires de la nuit
films.synopsis: 莱娅·米修斯执导。一场生日聚会被闯入者打断。哈芙齐亚·赫尔齐、伯努瓦·马吉梅、巴斯蒂安·布永、莫妮卡·贝鲁奇主演。法国片名 Histoires de la nuit。第79届戛纳主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Léa Mysius. A birthday party is interrupted by intruders. Starring Hafsia Herzi, Benoît Magimel, Bastien Bouillon and Monica Bellucci. French title Histoires de la nuit. In Competition at the 79th Cannes Film Festival.

films.title: 我爱的人
films.synopsis: 艾拉·萨克斯执导。拉米·马雷克、汤姆·斯塔里奇、卢瑟·福特、丽贝卡·豪尔主演。1980年代末纽约、一座受困之城的音乐狂想。第79届戛纳主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Ira Sachs. Starring Rami Malek, Tom Sturridge, Luther Ford and Rebecca Hall. A musical fantasia set in late-1980s New York, a city under siege. In Competition at the 79th Cannes Film Festival.

films.title: 陌生女子
films.synopsis: 亚瑟·哈拉里执导。摄影师（尼尔斯·施奈德）对一名女子（蕾雅·赛杜）无法移开目光，次日清晨发现自己活在她的身体里。法国片名 L'Inconnue。第79届戛纳主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Arthur Harari. A photographer (Niels Schneider) cannot take his eyes off a woman (Léa Seydoux), and wakes the next morning to find himself living inside her body. French title L'Inconnue. In Competition at the 79th Cannes Film Festival.

films.title: 一个女人的生活
films.titleEn: A Woman's Life / La vie d'une femme
films.synopsis: 沙尔琳·布尔热瓦-塔凯执导。55岁外科医生加布丽埃尔（蕾雅·德吕克尔）被工作占满，一位来科室取材的小说家（梅拉尼·蒂埃里）打乱了她的生活。第79届戛纳主竞赛，2026年5月13日首映；法国9月9日上映。与布里泽2016年《女人的一生》不是同一部片。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Charline Bourgeois-Tacquet. Gabrielle (Léa Drucker), a 55-year-old surgeon, is consumed by work until a novelist (Mélanie Thierry) who comes to the department for research upends her life. In Competition at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, premiering May 13, 2026; French release September 9. Not to be confused with Brizé's 2016 A Woman's Life.

films.title: 在海边
films.synopsis: 科尔内尔·蒙德拉佐执导。艾米·亚当斯饰一名舞者，戒瘾后回到科德角的家族老宅，清醒迫使她面对埋藏的创伤。穆雷·巴特利特、克洛艾·伊斯特、布雷特·戈尔茨坦、丹·列维出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Kornél Mundruczó. Amy Adams plays a dancer who returns to her family's Cape Cod home after getting sober, and sobriety forces her to confront buried trauma. Murray Bartlett, Chloe East, Brett Goldstein and Dan Levy co-star. In Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: Dao
films.synopsis: 阿兰·戈米斯执导。法国一场婚礼与几内亚比绍一场纪念仪式交织，写在两地之间生活的家族与传承。卡蒂·科雷亚、萨米尔·盖斯米出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Alain Gomis. A wedding in France and a commemorative ceremony in Guinea-Bissau intertwine, tracing a family and its legacy lived between two places. Starring Katy Correa and Samir Guesmi. In Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 尘埃
films.synopsis: 安克·布隆德执导，安杰洛·泰森斯编剧。1990年代末，比利时企业家吕克与海尔特得知空壳公司网络即将被国际媒体揭穿，只剩下作为自由人的最后一天。阿里耶·沃塔尔特出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Anke Blondé, written by Angelo Tijssens. In the late 1990s, Belgian entrepreneurs Luc and Geert learn that an international media outlet is about to expose their shell-company network, leaving them only one last day as free men. Starring Arieh Worthalter. In Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 家的故事
films.synopsis: 伊娃·特罗比施执导。选秀真人秀摄制组问莱娅：你是谁，什么定义了你。这是一个寻找自我的年轻女性，也是她那个不太平静的家庭的肖像。弗里达·霍内曼、马克斯·里梅尔特出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Eva Trobisch. A reality-talent-show crew asks Lea: who are you, and what defines you? A portrait of a young woman in search of herself, and of her rather turbulent family. Starring Frieda Hönemann and Max Riemelt. In Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 低声
films.titleEn: In a Whisper / À voix basse
films.synopsis: 莱拉·布齐德执导。莉利亚从巴黎回到突尼斯，决心查清舅舅猝死之谜。埃娅·布特拉、希亚姆·阿巴斯、玛丽昂·巴尔博出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Leïla Bouzid. Lilia returns from Paris to Tunisia, determined to uncover the mystery of her uncle's sudden death. Starring Eya Boutra, Hiam Abbass and Marion Barbeau. In Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 约瑟芬
films.synopsis: 贝丝·德·阿劳霍执导。八岁的约瑟芬在金门公园目击一桩罪行后开始用暴力保护自己，父母为正义与安全起了冲突。查宁·塔图姆、吉玛·陈主演。圣丹斯首映后，第76届柏林主竞赛国际首映。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Beth de Araújo. After witnessing a crime in Golden Gate Park, eight-year-old Josephine begins using violence to protect herself, and her parents clash over justice and safety. Starring Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan. Following its Sundance premiere, its international premiere is in Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 镇上最孤独的人
films.synopsis: 蒂扎·科维、莱纳·弗里梅尔执导。关于维也纳蓝调乐手阿尔·库克（阿洛伊斯·科赫）。住处面临拆除时，一个被遗忘已久的梦从废墟里重新浮现。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Tizza Covi and Rainer Frimmel. A film about Viennese blues musician Al Cook (Alois Koch). When his home faces demolition, a long-forgotten dream resurfaces from the ruins. In Competition at the 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 苍蝇
films.synopsis: 费尔南多·埃姆克执导。墨西哥城公寓楼里，生活极度规律的奥尔加因手头紧出租房间；房客偷偷把九岁儿子带了进来，她竟与孩子建立起联系。特蕾西塔·桑切斯、巴斯蒂安·埃斯科瓦尔主演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Fernando Eimbcke. In a Mexico City apartment building, Olga—whose life runs with rigid routine—rents out a room for much-needed cash; the tenant secretly brings in his nine-year-old son, and she unexpectedly forms a bond with the boy. Starring Tracie T. Sánchez and Bastián Escobar. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 我的妻子在哭
films.titleEn: My Wife Cries / Meine Frau weint
films.synopsis: 安格拉·沙内莱克执导。柏林一对夫妻：起重机司机托马斯等着幼儿园老师卡拉的电话。他找到她，陪她坐到愿意回家；走回去的路上，一个秘密把两人分开。弗拉基米尔·武莱维奇、阿加特·博尼策尔主演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Angela Schanelec. A couple in Berlin: crane operator Thomas waits for a call from kindergarten teacher Karla. He finds her and sits with her until she is ready to go home; on the walk back, a secret comes between them. Starring Vladimir Vulević and Agathe Bonitzer. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 新的黎明
films.synopsis: 四宫义俊动画长片首作。少年要赶在烟花工厂关闭前，解开父亲失踪前创造的那枚神话烟花之谜，并把它放上天。萩原利久、古川琴音、入野自由配音。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Yoshitoshi Shinomiya's animated feature debut. A boy races to solve the mystery of a mythical firework his father created before vanishing—and to set it off—before the fireworks factory closes. Voice cast: Riku Hagiwara, Kotone Furukawa, Miyu Irino. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 夜生
films.synopsis: 汉娜·贝格霍尔姆执导。塞迪·哈拉与鲁伯特·格林特饰一对夫妻，搬回芬兰森林的童年老宅准备成家；孩子出生后，只有母亲感觉到事情不对。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Hanna Bergholm. Sedi Hara and Rupert Grint play a couple who move back to a childhood home in the Finnish forest to start a family; after the child is born, only the mother senses something is wrong. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 修剪玫瑰丛
films.synopsis: 卡里姆·艾诺兹执导。一个麻烦不断的家庭在西班牙别墅里相撞。卡勒姆·特纳、莱莉·基奥、杰米·贝尔、艾丽·范宁、帕梅拉·安德森主演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Karim Aïnouz. A troubled family collides at a Spanish villa. Starring Callum Turner, Riley Keough, Jamie Bell, Elle Fanning and Pamela Anderson. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 苏姆苏姆，星夜
films.titleEn: Soumsoum, the Night of the Stars
films.synopsis: 马哈马特-萨利赫·哈龙执导。十七岁的凯卢得到自己无法理解的超自然能力，直到遇见四十来岁的阿娅，两人的命运缠在一起。迈穆娜·米亚瓦马、埃里克·埃布阿内出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Mahamat-Saleh Haroun. Seventeen-year-old Kailou gains a supernatural power she cannot understand, until she meets Aya, a woman in her forties, and their fates become entangled. Starring Maïmouna Miawama and Éric Abouané. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 钨
films.synopsis: 沃里克·桑顿执导，与2017年《甜蜜的国度》同一世界。1930年代澳大利亚殖民边疆，两名亡命之徒闯入矿镇；被逼下矿的原住民姐弟逃离白人监工，穿越中部沙漠寻找回家的路。德博拉·梅尔曼主演。第76届柏林主竞赛国际首映。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Warwick Thornton, set in the same world as his 2017 film Sweet Country. On Australia's colonial frontier in the 1930s, two outlaws burst into a mining town; an Aboriginal brother and sister forced to work the mine escape their white overseer and cross the central desert searching for the way home. Starring Deborah Mailman. International Premiere, Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: Yo：爱是一只叛逆的鸟
films.synopsis: 安娜·菲奇、班克·怀特执导的纪录长片，柏林主竞赛里唯一的纪录片形态作品。友人 Yo 去世后，安娜用十年做了一座三分之一比例的房子，小到她只能挤进门，里面住着 Yo 的偶人。约兰达·谢伊出演。第76届柏林主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: A documentary feature directed by Anna Fitch and Banker White—the only documentary-form work in Berlin's Main Competition. After the death of her friend Yo, Anna spends ten years building a one-third-scale house, small enough that she can only squeeze through the door, inhabited by a puppet of Yo. Starring Yolanda Shae. Main Competition, 76th Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: 坏父亲
films.synopsis: 罗伯托·布埃索执导。疏远多年后，作家兼院士圣地亚哥·巴尔梅斯召回三个孩子，提出最后一个愿望：回童年度假的房子过圣诞。爱德华·费尔南德斯主演。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Roberto Bueso. After years of estrangement, writer and academic Santiago Balmes summons his three children with a final wish: to spend Christmas at the house where they vacationed as children. Starring Eduard Fernández. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival.

films.title: 桑茨
films.synopsis: 米克尔·古雷亚执导。维多利亚·卢恩戈饰演的女人加入一伙偷窃宗教造像的人，同时面对母亲（阿丽亚德娜·吉尔）将至的死。片名 Sants 亦作 Saints。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Mikel Gurrea. Victoria Luengo plays a woman who joins a gang that steals religious statues while facing the impending death of her mother (Ariadna Gil). The film is titled Sants, also known as Saints. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival.

films.title: 再多五分钟
films.synopsis: 哈维尔·鲁伊斯·卡尔德拉执导的奇幻喜剧。看房的人从中介手里接过钥匙，对方离开之前，时间倒退了五分钟。贝尔托·罗梅罗、哈维尔·卡马拉主演。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛；卡马拉获银贝壳最佳配角。
directors: 哈维尔·鲁伊斯·卡尔德拉
films.synopsisEn: A fantasy comedy directed by Javier Ruiz Caldera. A prospective buyer takes the keys from the agent, and before the agent leaves, time rewinds five minutes. Starring Berto Romero and Javier Cámara. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival; Cámara won the Silver Shell for Best Supporting Performance.

films.title: 我的忧伤亡者
films.titleEn: My Sad Dead / Mis muertos tristes
films.synopsis: 巴勃罗·拉雷恩执导。改编自玛丽安娜·恩里克斯，以剧集的长片形态在电影节放映。刚退休的医生艾玛看得见死者，她试着消化母亲的死和自己未了的事。梅赛德斯·莫兰、多洛雷斯·丰齐、卡罗琳娜·阿尔瓦雷斯主演。阿根廷、智利。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Pablo Larraín. Adapted from Mariana Enríquez, screened at the festival in feature-length form as part of a series. Newly retired doctor Emma can see the dead, and tries to come to terms with her mother's death and her own unfinished business. Starring Mercedes Morán, Dolores Fonzi and Carolina Álvarez. Argentina, Chile. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival.

films.title: 米洛
films.synopsis: 妮科尔·加西亚执导。法国片名《7h40 ce matin-là》，英文片单作 Milo。玛丽昂·科蒂亚尔饰刚出狱的艾丽斯，在法国小城咖啡馆做服务员，接近汽修厂青年米洛（泰奥多尔·佩兰），却不说出自己是他的母亲。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛；法国定于2027年1月20日上映。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Nicole Garcia. The French title is 7h40 ce matin-là; the English-language listing is Milo. Marion Cotillard plays Alice, newly released from prison, working as a waitress in a café in a small French town; she grows close to Milo (Théodore Pellerin), a young man at an auto repair shop, without revealing that she is his mother. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival; French release set for January 20, 2027.

films.title: 父亲的房间
films.titleEn: In My Father's Room / Muyou no Hito
films.synopsis: 原田真波长片首作，剧本据其小说《An Unnecessary Man》。博物馆职员收到一把钥匙，能打开已故父亲曾经使用的房间。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Mana Harada's feature debut, with a screenplay based on her novel An Unnecessary Man. A museum employee receives a key that opens the room once used by her late father. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival.

films.title: Glaxo
films.synopsis: 本哈明·奈什塔特执导，改编自埃尔南·龙西诺同名小说。1957年阿根廷奇维尔科伊，一名阴森的前警长与他的妻子到来，拆开了四个形影不离的青年。拉利·埃斯波西托、马塞洛·苏维奥托、埃斯特万·比利阿尔迪主演。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Benjamín Naishtat, adapted from Hernán Ronsino's novel of the same name. In 1957 Chivilcoy, Argentina, the arrival of a sinister former police chief and his wife drives apart four inseparable young friends. Starring Lali Espósito, Marcelo Subiotto and Esteban Bigliardi. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival.

films.title: 余物
films.synopsis: 耶希姆·乌斯塔奥卢执导。一位女诗人挣脱令人窒息的生活秩序，重新连回自己，并质疑周遭的一切。土耳其片名 Artakalan。第74届圣塞巴斯蒂安主竞赛。与其他同名 What Remains 不是同一部片。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Yeşim Ustaoğlu. A woman poet breaks free from a suffocating order of life, reconnects with herself and questions everything around her. The Turkish title is Artakalan. Main Competition, 74th San Sebastián Film Festival. Not to be confused with other films of the same name, What Remains.

films.title: 功夫
films.synopsis: 九把刀执导编剧，改编自其小说《都市恐怖病》同名篇章。戴立忍、柯震东、朱轩洋、王净、刘冠廷主演。2026年2月13日台湾上映。第63届金马奖最佳男主角（戴立忍）入围。与周星驰《功夫》不是同一部片。
films.synopsisEn: Directed and written by Giddens Ko, adapted from the titular chapter of his novel City Horror Disease. Starring Leon Dai, Kai Ko, Chu Hsuan-yang, Gingle Wang, and Liu Kuan-ting. Taiwan release on February 13, 2026. Nominated for Best Actor (Leon Dai) at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards. Not the same film as Stephen Chow's Kung Fu.

films.title: 黑潮
films.synopsis: 池家庆执导，李心洁、王礼霖监制。刑满出狱的阿忠回到马来西亚渔村，遇见被家人幽禁在高脚屋的雪。陈泽耀、李沐主演。2026年11月13日台湾上映。第63届金马奖最佳男主角（陈泽耀）入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed by Chi Chia-ching, produced by Angelica Lee and Wong Lai-lam. Ah Zhong, newly released from prison, returns to a Malaysian fishing village and meets Xue, kept locked away by her family in a stilt house. Starring Chen Tse-yao and Li Mu. Taiwan release on November 13, 2026. Nominated for Best Actor (Chen Tse-yao) at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 第四幕
films.synopsis: 王德健执导编剧，尔冬升监制，长片首作。过气导演欧文（冯德伦）为挽回尊严自编自导新作，征选中遇见素人汉娜（袁澧林），在首演之夜迷失于戏剧与现实。胡杏儿、周秀娜出演。第28届上海国际电影节开幕片；2026年11月12日香港上映。金马63最佳女主角（袁澧林）入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed and written by Wong Tak-kin, produced by Derek Yee, feature debut. Washed-up director Owen (Stephen Fung) writes and directs a new film to reclaim his dignity, meets amateur actress Hannah (Yuen Lai-lam) during casting, and loses himself between drama and reality on opening night. Also starring Myolie Wu and Chrissie Chau. Opening film of the 28th Shanghai International Film Festival; Hong Kong release on November 12, 2026. Nominated for Best Actress (Yuen Lai-lam) at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 谎言生活
films.synopsis: 周彤执导编剧，长片首作，纽约唐人街实景。除夕夜，肖蕾带假男友回父母家，真正的恋人却意外到访。梁翠珊、孙嘉灵主演。第83届威尼斯地平线单元；第63届金马奖最佳女主角（梁翠珊）与最佳新导演（周彤）入围。
films.synopsisEn: Directed and written by Zhou Tong, feature debut, shot on location in New York's Chinatown. On New Year's Eve, Xiao Lei brings a fake boyfriend home to her parents, but her real lover shows up unexpectedly. Starring Liang Cui-shan and Sun Jia-ling. Venice Horizons section at the 83rd Venice Film Festival; nominated for Best Actress (Liang Cui-shan) and Best New Director (Zhou Tong) at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 泡泡糖女孩
films.synopsis: 洪玉桔自编自导长片首作，取材其童年。1990年代新加坡组屋，七岁女孩面对父母分居。王宣静、王雪萁、黄思恬主演。2026年鹿特丹电影节青年评审团奖。第63届金马奖最佳新导演（洪玉桔）入围。
films.synopsisEn: Written and directed by Hong Yu-jie as her feature debut, drawn from her own childhood. In a 1990s Singapore HDB flat, a seven-year-old girl faces her parents' separation. Starring Wang Xuan-jing, Wang Xue-qi, and Huang Si-tian. Won the Young Jury Award at the 2026 Rotterdam Film Festival. Nominated for Best New Director (Hong Yu-jie) at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.

films.title: 泥娃娃
films.synopsis: 解孟儒首部剧情长片。杨祐宁、蔡思韵、张轩睿、郭雪芙、周采诗主演。2025年10月9日台湾上映。第63届金马奖最佳新导演（解孟儒）、最佳视觉效果、最佳动作设计入围。
films.synopsisEn: Xie Meng-ru's first narrative feature. Starring Yang Yu-ning, Cai Si-yun, Zhang Xuan-rui, Guo Xue-fu, and Zhou Cai-shi. Taiwan release on October 9, 2025. Nominated for Best New Director (Xie Meng-ru), Best Visual Effects, and Best Action Choreography at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards.
